title: Centipede Console Ritual
description: A glowing blue muscular humanoid figure is trapped inside a transparent cylindrical chamber within a purple stone dungeon. In the foreground, a large mechanical console with green accents is operated by a black centipede-like creature with human hands holding a cigarette, while green energy swirls around the floor and a broken moon is visible through an arched window.
prompt: A surreal scene inside a purple stone dungeon with glowing yellow circuit patterns. A muscular blue humanoid is trapped in a tall glass cylinder emitting green and purple smoke. In the foreground, a large grey and green retro-futuristic console is being operated by a giant black centipede creature with pale human hands holding a cigarette. A bright green orb glows on the checkered floor. Through a gothic window, a cracked green moon hangs over rolling hills. Cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
